Use Case

One control tower for every site

Running five projects means five supply chains, five sets of fires, and no single view. IntelliByld puts every site into one live control tower so materials, risk, and capacity can be balanced across the portfolio, not just within one job.

Every site reports to one twin; the tower rebalances across the portfolio.
The shift

Balance the portfolio, not just the project

When one site is short on rebar and another is sitting on a surplus, the answer is obvious but only if someone can see both at once. A shared twin makes cross-site moves visible and actionable instead of accidental.

  • One source of truth. Every site's materials, schedule, and risk live in the same model, at the same freshness.
  • Cross-site moves. Surplus on one job can cover a shortfall on another before either becomes an emergency order.
  • Portfolio-level risk. A supplier wobble that touches three sites is seen as one risk, not three disconnected surprises.

FAQs

What changes across the portfolio, answered

Do all sites need to be on the same systems?

No. The control tower sits above whatever each site already runs and normalizes the picture. New sites are added by connecting their BOMs and channels just like the same lightweight pilot path.

Can teams still operate independently?

Yes. Each site keeps its own workflow; the tower adds a portfolio layer on top for visibility and cross-site moves, without forcing every project into one process.
